diff_review: task/get plus a local read-only view of the `file diff` attachment (clipped to 100000 bytes); integration requires the exact expectedCommit and a review note
context_compaction: paged event/list catch-up (500/page, 20-page cap) yields the exact session revision; context/compact uses it as expectedRevision and retries once on `context changed` while preserving the typed summary
session_creation: interactive repository/validation/requirement form prefilled from CLI options; validation split into argument arrays without shell concatenation
